# Slide Decks

Each week's lecture slides are built with Quarto Reveal.js. Click a link below to view the deck in your browser.

## Available Decks

- [Week 1: Course Introduction](slides/week-01.qmd)

## How to Add a New Deck

1. Create `slides/week-NN.qmd` using `slides/week-01.qmd` as a template.
2. Add a link on this page.
3. Add a row in the [schedule](schedule.qmd).
4. Add the file to the sidebar in `_quarto.yml` under the "Slides" section.
5. Run `quarto render` to rebuild the site.
